configurePresets.name: sanitize_asan
configurePresets.description: Fragment: CT_ADDRESS_SANITIZER=ON. Inherit alongside a native platform preset; provides the Debug build/test presets only.

configurePresets.name: sanitize_ubsan
configurePresets.description: Fragment: CT_UNDEFINED_BEHAVIOR_SANITIZER=ON with -fno-sanitize-recover=all (aborts on first error). Inherit alongside a native platform preset.

configurePresets.name: sanitize_tsan
configurePresets.description: Fragment: CT_THREAD_SANITIZER=ON. Incompatible with AddressSanitizer — never inherit both. Inherit alongside a native platform preset.

configurePresets.name: sanitize_asan_ubsan
configurePresets.description: Composed fragment: inherits sanitize_asan + sanitize_ubsan. The standard combined memory debugging build.

configurePresets.name: valgrind
configurePresets.description: Fragment: CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR runs every test under valgrind memcheck (--error-exitcode=1 so CTest fails on errors). The emulator — not TEST_LAUNCHER — is used because doctest_discover_tests bakes absolute paths at build time and only honors the target CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR as its TEST_EXECUTOR. Needs no compile flags: inherit alongside a native platform preset, never with a sanitizer preset.

testPresets.name: sanitize_test_base
testPresets.description: Fragment: ASan/UBSan/TSan abort on first error so CTest reports failures instead of continuing past them.
